image_title: Infosys Consolidated Financial Data - Q2 Fiscal 2025
summary: This table presents the consolidated financial data for Infosys for the second quarter of fiscal 2025, highlighting key metrics such as a 3.1% quarter-over-quarter and 3.3% year-over-year growth in constant currency. The operating margin stands at 21.1%, with a 4.7% increase in earnings per share. Revenue is segmented by business areas, showing financial services as the largest contributor at 27.2%, followed by retail and communication. Geographically, North America leads with 57.4% of total revenue. The client data section indicates a total of 1,870 active clients, with significant contributions from the top client segments. Overall, the data reflects stable growth and a strong client base.
table_rows: Revenues by Business Segments: Financial Services = 27.2%, Retail = 13.3%, Communication = 11.9%, Energy, Utilities, Resources & Services = 13.5%, Manufacturing = 15.7%, Hi-Tech = 8.0%, Life Sciences = 7.3%, Others = 3.1%
Revenues by Client Geography: North America = 57.4%, Europe = 29.8%, Rest of the World = 9.7%, India = 3.1%
